author: GamingBolt
description:
In hindsight, I probably should have waited before asking where The Elder Scrolls 6 is, eight years after its announcement. But in my defense, how could anyone have guessed that Xbox's approach (allegedly) to shipping one of the most anticipated games of all time was to kneecap the development team?

I'm getting ahead of myself. Let's start from right after Xbox announced layoffs for 1,600 employees across a myriad of studios, with 1,600 more coming in the next 12 months. It didn't matter who you were a part of – Activision, King, Mojang, Blizzard, Bethesda – everyone was under the radar. Aside from studios like Ninja Theory, Compulsion Games, Double Fine, and Undead Labs, which either went independent or were acquired.

Now, Xbox didn't come out and say which studios were affected, but based on reports and WARN notices issued in Maryland, the devastation is significant. ZeniMax Online Studios, responsible for The Elder Scrolls Online, had 213 layoffs, raising huge questions over the
title: The Elder Scrolls 6 May Be Absolutely Cooked

author: GamingBolt
description:
College Football 27 came bearing the high expectations of a franchise entry that would take its revival forward into a new chapter that would be just as rewarding for players as it would be for EA. However, that dream might be vanishing into the ether with a bunch of issues holding back what is a very good football sim.

What are these issues we speak of? Are they really bad enough to derail an instalment that’s touted to bring so many cool new things to the table? Join us and find out as we dive deep into this one, and help you decide if perhaps holding off on picking it up right away might not be too bad an idea.
title: EA SPORTS College Football 27 - What The Hell Is Going On?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Sony’s push towards a digital-only future for the PlayStation has been the center of many discussions, spanning important topics in modern gaming discourse. But are things as bad as the critics would have you believe? Or could they get worse? We’d say not yet, as there’s a lot of nuance to what’s being said, and always time for an experienced hand like Sony to find a way to turn things around.

But even we can’t deny there’s cause for concern among gamers and even developers.
title: PlayStation Didn't Just Kill Discs - It Sparked a Full-Blown Revolt Across The Industry
